claims.summary: The host cites about $45–50 billion of physical-AI venture funding in the first half of 2026, around 450 deals, and growth of roughly 80% from 2025.
Vertical physical-AI applications may commercialize earlier and avoid some of the dilution of general-purpose robotics bets.
For startups selling to government, the harder problem may now be delivering a large contract rather than winning it.
The panel says Starcloud raised $250 million at a $2.3 billion valuation for orbital data centers.
Control of sensitive data is an integrity and fiduciary issue, not only a procurement decision.

limits: No independent verification of policy, company, funding, valuation, or market-size claims was performed.
